scripts.test:unit:coverage: mkdir -p coverage && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="www/**" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/js.lcov test/unit/*.test.js && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs js
scripts.test:ios: cd test/ios && xcodebuild test -scheme SpeechRecognitionTests-Package -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=$(node simulator.mjs)" -skipPackagePluginValidation
scripts.test:ios:coverage: cd test/ios && ./coverage.sh && cd ../.. && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs ios
scripts.test:android:coverage: cd test/android && ./gradlew createDebugUnitTestCoverageReport && cd ../.. && node test/coverage/summarize.mjs android
